header.title: What you run in Sttok
header.description: Companies, corporate groups, law firms and in-house legal teams run their shareholder register, meetings and board in Sttok, with built-in communications and e-signature, and their incentive plans.

items.title: Shareholders
items.content: Official shareholder register, percentages, shareholder access and share certificate register
items.alt: Shareholder register in Sttok: list of shareholders with their shares, par value and premium, and their undiluted and fully diluted percentage

items.title: Meetings and Boards
items.content: Digital notices, proxies, quorum, voting and minutes
items.alt: Shareholder meeting in Sttok: quorum on first call, shareholders present and represented, and voting open item by item

items.title: Communications and Signatures
items.content: Built-in communications and e-signature, with automatic filing in the company records
items.alt: Signatures and communications in Sttok. Built-in email delivery of notices and notifications. Built-in e-signature with DocuSign. Everything is logged, certified and filed.

items.title: Incentive Plans
items.content: Phantoms, stock options, vesting and employee portal
items.alt: Incentive plan in Sttok: phantom beneficiary portal with vested units, their value and an open sale window
